csv_project_name: Architectural & Design Service for Berkeley Ballpark
csv_scope_of_work: Henderson County is soliciting services from highly qualified Architectural Firms, to provide programming/design/consultant services, for Henderson County Government, for the Berkeley Ballpark at Henderson County Sports Complex. The scope of the project is a proposed renovation of the historic Berkeley Ballpark, inclusive of playing surface, concourse, dugouts, concession stand, and grandstand. Even though the final budget is yet to be determined, the estimated all-in budget of the project should be approximately 2-3 million dollars. The awarded Architect will perform the following tasks, in order to complete the Berkeley Ballpark renovation at the Henderson County Sports Complex, for Henderson County.
